text.card: A red giant 14,708 parsecs away, 22 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 2.77 solar masses and 22.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,264 K at its surface.
